content: Official vendor pages 2025 (Huckleberry, Nighp Baby Tracker, Glow Baby, Cubtale) show feature baseline: 1-tap timers for feed/sleep/diaper; breast side + bottle amount + pumping + solids; customizable logging (show what you care about, hide the rest); growth measurements, milestones, medication, temperature, vaccines; charts plus daily/weekly/monthly reports; multi-caregiver sync; Huckleberry tiers Free / Plus 11.99-mo / Premium 14.99-mo with SweetSpot in Plus, AI logging via text-voice-photo, widgets and Apple Watch in Premium
